note: What a server sends to light up part of the screen, as a tutorial does. Only HudHighlightToggled turns it off. The header carries zero.

fields.name: part
fields.note: Which part of the screen. A client ignores any other value.

0.name: hud
0.note: The main controls along the bottom.

2.name: minimap
2.note: The minimap; a client acts on element 0 only, its camera button, and only once it knows its own champion.

fields.name: element
fields.note: What to light up on the main controls. A client ignores any value above 8.

0.name: spell
0.note: A spell's button; number names its slot, 0 to 3.

2.name: summonerSpell
2.note: A summoner spell's button; number names its slot, 0 or 1.

6.name: experience
6.note: Sized to the progress through the level.

fields.name: number
fields.note: Which slot, for a spell or a summoner spell; unread otherwise. A client does not check it, and a slot beyond those named has no defined effect.

fields.name: unused
fields.note: A client does not read it.
